material_findings.fact: Both server acceptance and Root client constructor call os.pidfd_open directly. The intended Root runtime is the retained pinned /usr/bin/python3 SHA298a9e83 (Python3.8), confirmed by the implementation owner; this runtime does not provide that Python API. The existing registered pidfd_compat068e is the available compatibility source.
material_findings.effect: The legitimate Root client cannot complete construction on its declared actual interpreter; a new interpreter/tool probe or assumed upgrade is not a repair.
material_findings.minimum_correction: Use the genuine registered pidfd_compat implementation through a copied/hash-pinned dependency for both controller and immutable client package, retaining exact PID/birth and pidfd liveness checks. Bind the actual owning-controller interpreter in the eventual transition packet.

material_findings.fact: The except branch calls self.save before close; if receipt persistence raises, no cleanup is attempted. Campaign.run finally does not close native_owner_control on normal stop, checkpoint, exception or KeyboardInterrupt. CurrentOwnerServer.close and CurrentOwnerSession.close stop cleanup at the first close/lstat/unlink failure after setting closed=True, preventing later handles from being attempted and a later close from retrying. Client handle fields are initialized only after first path validation, so an externally preallocated failed client may not support close at its first error boundary.
material_findings.effect: Owned data-channel sockets/pidfds/path can survive a completed/error handoff or remain unaccounted while the owning process continues shutdown. A secondary receipt/cleanup error can replace the original failure. No Native/resource release follows, but the stated component lifecycle contract is not met.
material_findings.minimum_correction: Put all owned-channel cleanup behind finally before/independent of diagnostic writes, close the service in the existing Campaign.run shutdown finally, initialize client handle/closed fields before validations, and attempt every owned handle even when another close fails. Preserve primary exception/KeyboardInterrupt and record secondary cleanup/receipt errors without deleting or releasing any Native/source/resource lease. The future NativeGate must still preallocate and retain the Root client before constructor as already specified.

material_findings.fact: receive() loops over independent sock.recv calls while the socket has a 15-second timeout. Each successful partial read renews that timeout; there is no absolute deadline for the whole length header plus body. MAX_FRAME bounds bytes, not elapsed time. The server calls this synchronously inside the sole owning Campaign event loop.
material_findings.effect: A stalled/fragmented control frame can keep that loop blocked far beyond the stated bounded handoff interval, delaying stop/checkpoint/account monitoring. No payload execution is needed to establish this source-level error.
material_findings.minimum_correction: Apply one monotonic absolute deadline across the entire framed handoff (header/body and relevant send/read boundary), updating each operation timeout from remaining time and failing when it expires. Do not create another controller, permission fallback, unbounded wait or native grant.
